findings.where: src/pages/StockMind/chartEmptyState.js, the `nothing-in-window` branch: `detail: coverage?.first ? `stored ${coverage.first} → ${coverage.last || 'now'}` : null` — and the assertion that locks it in, scripts/verifyChartEmptyState.mjs: 'a missing storedLastBar reads as "now" rather than as undefined'.
findings.problem: Item 2 removed the false headline but put a false sentence directly under it. `ai_backend/main.py`'s `matched == 0` branch sends `storedFirstBar` and NO `storedLastBar` — that branch and only that branch — so in the very state this tranche exists for, `coverage.last` is always null and the overlay always renders `stored 2019-04-01 → now`. Reproduced by calling `emptyState()` with the route's literal reply: headline '400 30m bars are stored, but none fall between 2024-01-01 and 2024-02-01...' sits above 'stored 2019-04-01 → now'. The two cannot both be true — if the store reached now, a 2024 window would have matched — and the false half is the one telling master which window to aim at.
findings.fix: Render only what is known: when `coverage.last` is falsy emit `stored from ${coverage.first}` (no arrow, no right-hand side), keeping `→ ${coverage.last}` for the success branch where the route does send it. Then change the suite assertion to require that the unknown end is NOT rendered as a date or as 'now', and add a case asserting the detail never claims an end the reply did not carry.

findings.where: src/pages/StockMind/StockMind.jsx around line 774 — the `{barsNote && (...)}` amber band with its nested `engine output` details and `engineDetail` line — against src/pages/StockMind/PopoutPanel.jsx, which this diff changed to `{error && bars.length > 0 && (...)}`.
findings.problem: `barsFail` now reaches both StockMind charts and the overlay prints the reason, the remedy, the knocked URL and the collapsed engine output. `barsNote` is still set to `res.error` on the same failure and its band was left ungated, so with the engine down and no candles the chart tab reports one failure twice, with two identical collapsed `engine output` blocks and two copies of `engineDetail`. The pop-out side of the same commit gated its band for exactly this reason and wrote the reasoning in a comment; the two files are now asymmetric. Master's engine has never completed a run, so this is the state he actually sees.
findings.fix: Gate the band the same way the pop-out was gated — `{barsNote && bars.length > 0 && (...)}` — so it only covers the case the overlay cannot (a failed refresh over still-drawn candles). If the band must stay visible when the chart is empty, strip its `engineTail`/`engineDetail` children instead, since the overlay now carries both.

findings.where: src/pages/StockMind/PopoutPanel.jsx — the `<PriceChart>` call passes `onFetch={loadBars}` and no `onDates`; src/pages/StockMind/PriceChart.jsx gates the button on `vacancy.action?.id === 'clear-dates' && onDates`.
findings.problem: In the pop-out a `nothing-in-window` state would render the route's headline advising that the dates be widened with no control to widen them — no action at all. It is unreachable today only because the pop-out calls `limitForDates(interval, null, null)` and sends no dates, so `/ohlcv` never takes the `matched == 0` branch; the dead end is one prop away.
findings.fix: Either pass an `onDates` the pop-out can honour, or assert in scripts/verifyChartEmptyState.mjs that the pop-out call site sends no dates, so that threading dates there later fails the suite rather than shipping an actionless overlay.

findings.problem: Sections 1-6 assert behaviour by calling `emptyState()`; section 7 asserts source text. The patterns are whitespace-exact, so wrapping a JSX attribute across lines fails a green suite, and the call-site count is a hardcoded total over two hardcoded files — a fourth `<PriceChart` added in a new file leaves the suite passing while reintroducing the one-of-three defect this tranche fixed.
findings.fix: Match on attribute names rather than full expressions (`/replyNote=\{/`), and discover the call sites by scanning `src/pages/StockMind/*.jsx` for `<PriceChart`, asserting that every file containing one also contains `coverage=`, `replyNote=` and `failure=`, instead of pinning a count.
